project.name: Video Capture Reliability
project.description: Fix broken video capture in the Hearted Safari extension by using Twitter's Syndication API for server-side video URL resolution, replacing the unreliable DOM scraping approach. Includes UX improvements for video feedback, pre-flight API key validation, integration tests, and security hardening.

key_tradeoffs: Server-side resolution adds ~200-500ms per video tweet but eliminates DOM scraping fragility
Syndication API is undocumented but has been stable since 2020 and powers Twitter's own embed system
PerformanceObserver fallback deferred to future work — Syndication API handles the vast majority of cases
Page scope expansion (bookmarks/home) explicitly rejected as scope creep for a personal tool

stories.title: Server-side Syndication API video URL resolution
stories.description: When capture_tweet receives a tweet with has_video=true but no video_url, call Twitter's Syndication API (cdn.syndication.twimg.com/tweet-result?id={tweet_id}) to resolve the highest-bitrate MP4 URL, then proceed with existing download_video_direct pipeline. The enrichment code at api.py:1112-1156 already calls this API but only extracts images — extend it to extract video variants.
acceptance_criteria: New resolve_video_via_syndication() function in api.py that calls cdn.syndication.twimg.com/tweet-result
Function extracts mediaDetails[].video_info.variants[], filters for video/mp4 content_type, selects highest bitrate
Called in capture_tweet when has_video=true and video_url is null/empty
Resolved URL is stored in raw_data.video_url and raw_data.video_resolved_via='syndication_api'
If Syndication API fails (timeout, 404, rate limit), tweet is still saved with video_download_status='pending' for retry
Syndication API call has 10-second timeout to avoid blocking the capture pipeline
Logging: [SYNDICATION] with tweet_id, response status, and resolved URL (truncated)
stories.notes: Added resolve_video_via_syndication() helper at api.py:19-55. Integrated into capture_tweet at line 672 and enrichment at line 1209. 10s timeout, highest-bitrate MP4 selection, graceful degradation.

stories.title: Update video retry endpoint to use Syndication API
stories.description: The /api/video/retry endpoint (api.py:930) retries failed video downloads. When a pending item has no video_url, it should call resolve_video_via_syndication() to get a fresh URL before attempting download. This also handles expired CDN token URLs from the initial capture.
acceptance_criteria: video_retry endpoint calls resolve_video_via_syndication() for items with video_url=null or video_download_status='pending'
Fresh Syndication resolution handles expired CDN auth tokens from initial capture
Retry count is still respected (max 3 retries per existing logic)
Items that fail Syndication resolution are marked with descriptive error in video_download_error field
stories.notes: Added Syndication API fallback to video_retry endpoint at line 1031. Re-resolves expired CDN tokens via fresh Syndication API call. Respects existing retry count limit.

stories.title: Pre-flight API key validation in extension
stories.description: Validate the API key before capture starts. When user clicks Start Capture, send a lightweight request to verify the key works. If invalid, show a persistent error banner instead of starting capture. Also validate when key is saved in popup settings.
acceptance_criteria: On Start Capture click, background.js validates API key via GET /api/stats before content script begins scanning
If key is missing: show persistent banner 'Set your API key in the Hearted extension popup'
If key is invalid (401): show persistent banner 'Invalid API key — check your settings'
If server unreachable: show persistent banner 'Cannot reach h3arted.com'
isCapturing is NOT set to true until validation succeeds
In popup.js, validate key on save by calling GET /api/stats and showing success/failure status
Validation result is cached — not repeated per-tweet
stories.notes: Superseded: error visibility shipped in commit 8f72324 (content-x.js rewrite with toast notifications, error classification, failure counter). Pre-flight validation partially covered by video-2 multi-strategy extraction.

stories.title: Video-specific UX feedback in content script
stories.description: Differentiate visual feedback for video captures so users can see when video URLs are missing. Replace the uniform pink border with content-type-aware indicators.
acceptance_criteria: Text-only tweets: blue left border (#42a5f5)
Image tweets: pink left border (#e91e63, current default)
Video tweets with URL captured: green left border (#4caf50)
Video tweets WITHOUT URL: amber left border (#ff9800) — indicates server will resolve via Syndication API
Count badge shows breakdown: e.g. '32 / 10img / 5vid' or similar compact format
Error toast deduplication: identical error messages suppressed within 10-second window
Session-end summary when user stops capture: total captured, breakdown by type, failures
stories.notes: Partially superseded: video-2 (f54d7fdb) added 3-strategy extraction with content type detection. Full UX differentiation (color-coded borders, session summary) remains as future enhancement.

stories.title: Integration tests for video capture pipeline
stories.description: Add integration tests covering the Syndication API resolution path, the video retry endpoint with Syndication, and the capture_tweet endpoint for video tweets with missing URLs.
acceptance_criteria: Test: capture_tweet with has_video=true, video_url=null calls resolve_video_via_syndication and stores resolved URL
Test: capture_tweet still saves tweet metadata when Syndication API fails (graceful degradation)
Test: resolve_video_via_syndication selects highest bitrate MP4 from variants array
Test: resolve_video_via_syndication returns None for non-video tweets, deleted tweets, API errors
Test: video_retry uses Syndication API for pending items without video_url
Test: Syndication API timeout (10s) does not block capture pipeline beyond 10s
All tests use mocked httpx.AsyncClient for Syndication API calls (no real network)
Tests pass with pytest -v
stories.notes: 12 tests in test_video_syndication.py: highest bitrate selection, m3u8 exclusion, image-only/text-only tweets, 404/429/timeout/network-error, malformed JSON, missing video_info, empty variants, correct API params. All 29 video tests pass.

stories.title: Security hardening and documentation
stories.description: Apply targeted security fixes identified during deliberation. Fix timing-vulnerable API key comparison, add redirect validation on video downloads, and update misleading code comments.
acceptance_criteria: API key comparison in dependencies.py uses hmac.compare_digest() instead of == or !=
download_video_direct validates redirect URLs (either disable follow_redirects or add event_hook)
Comment in content-x.js video extraction section explains known blob URL limitation and server-side Syndication API resolution
Comment block documents video_download_status state machine (null/pending/downloaded/failed/too_large) near capture_tweet
Hardcoded Supabase URL default removed from storage.py — require via environment variable
stories.notes: Partially superseded: video-4 (71c5fbc1) shipped CDN allowlist validation, streaming downloads with redirect SSRF validation, size caps. video-6 (6f25eba3) added 17 security tests. hmac.compare_digest and Supabase URL default removal remain as future enhancements.

technical_notes.syndication_api: Twitter's undocumented API at cdn.syndication.twimg.com/tweet-result?id={TWEET_ID}&token={RANDOM} returns full tweet JSON with mediaDetails[].video_info.variants[] containing direct MP4 URLs at multiple bitrates. No authentication required. Already used in api.py:1112-1156 for image enrichment but video variants are currently ignored.
technical_notes.existing_code: The enrichment endpoint at api.py:1114-1119 already fetches from the Syndication API. The capture_tweet endpoint at api.py:611-637 already handles has_video + video_url for download_video_direct. The fix connects these two existing capabilities.
rejected_approaches: Main-world fetch interception: HIGH security risk, detectable by Twitter, fragile against CSP changes
ffmpeg on Railway: memory/disk constraints, adds binary dependency, yt-dlp fallback on localhost already covers this
Page scope expansion to /bookmarks and /home: scope creep, increases selector maintenance burden
MediaSource/SourceBuffer hooks: over-engineered, Syndication API achieves the same goal with 1/10th the code
technical_notes.performance_advisory: Syndication API call adds ~200-500ms per video tweet. This is acceptable since video tweets are ~10-20% of content. The call has a 10-second timeout. If it becomes a bottleneck, consider async resolution via FastAPI BackgroundTasks (return 202, process video later).
